Footer.brandTagline: Promoting the Colombian culture of the Carnival of Barranquilla in Utah since 2022.

Home.subtitle: Experience Colombian culture in Utah. Learn the traditional dances of the world's largest carnival with our expert instructors.

About.description: Founded by <directors>Mayra Rincón and Marilyn Gallardo</directors>, we are the only academy in Utah preserving the authentic dances of the Carnival of Barranquilla, declared a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage.
About.marimondaDescription: Eternal symbol of the Carnival. Its iconic mask represents freedom, joy, and rebellion against seriousness.

Dances.subtitle: From the most traditional to the urban. We teach you the full richness of Colombian Caribbean culture.

main.cumbia: The oldest dance of the Carnival. Smooth, captivating movements full of African, Indigenous, and Spanish history.
main.mapale: Free and energetic Afro-Colombian rhythm. Pure expression.
main.garabato: Folkloric dance with fluid and elegant choreography. Represents the symbolic struggle between life and death.

more.champeta: Afro-Caribbean rhythm born in Cartagena. Sensual and energetic movements.
more.salsa: The most popular rhythm in Latin America. Elegant steps with contagious energy.
more.sonDeNegro: Ancestral Afro-Colombian dance. Drums, masks, and deep cultural roots.
more.bullerengue: Drum rhythm with female voices. The essence of the Colombian Caribbean.
more.urbano: Reggaeton, dancehall, and modern styles. The fusion of the Caribbean with the contemporary.
more.marimondas: The dance of the Carnival's iconic character. Pure joy, freedom, and rebellion.
